title: SkyBlock But Better!
body:
# A data pack that enhances vanilla skyblock!

 This data pack is a WORK IN PROGRESS and will continually be updated to remain balanced and feature-full.

 The goal of this pack is to allow for a skyblock playthrough to be true to vanilla while improving on the default limitations inherent in the game.

###  Commands

As of now you have to manually set up the world to use the custom dimension.

1- Create a new world and make sure commands are allowed. (It will also be best to start in creative.)
```
/execute in skyblock:skyblock_dim run tp @a 0 0 0
```

2- Create your island, plant a tree, and start playing!
```
/fill ~1 ~ ~1 ~-1 ~ ~-1 minecraft:grass_block
```

##  Features
- Custom Dimension & Biome
- Custom Loot Tables
- Custom Advancements

## Planned Features
- Full progression system using advancements
- Black Market Wandering Trader
- Improved Loot Tables
- World Presets

## Resources Used
[Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/):
- Timber
- Fast Leaf Decay
- Husks Drop Sand
- More Mob Heads
- Wandering Trader Announcements
- Crafting Tweaks
